notes: Ask the room: who has fixed the same logo or typo on thirty slides?

values.title: Slide decks get messy
values.lede: Most decks start neat. Then every slide gets nudged by hand, until no two look quite alike.
bullets: Copy a slide to reuse its layout, and the copies drift apart
A design fix means editing **every slide**, one by one
Mistakes show up on the projector, not before
Hard to review, and hard for an AI agent to edit safely
